camel_example: aliyun mse CreateOrUpdateSwimmingLane --region cn-hangzhou --PathIndependentPercentageEnable false --Name gray --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Divisor 10 --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Name 'x-mse-tag' --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Cond '==' --Enable true --AcceptLanguage zh --EnableRules false --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.NameList.1 test --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Value gray --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Operator rawvalue --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Datum x --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Rate 30 --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Remainder 10 --GatewaySwimmingLaneRouteJson '{"Condition":"AND","GatewayUniqueId":"gw-84efde2ee1464260bdb17a5b0000","RouteIndependentPercentageList":[{"Percentage":50,"RouteId":111}],"Percentage":30,"RouteIdList":[1],"RouteIndependentPercentageEnable":true,"CanaryModel":0,"GatewayId":1,"Conditions":[{"Type":"header","Cond":"PRE","Value":"xiaoming","Name":"name"}]}' --Namespace default --GroupId 115 --EntryRule 'Priority_:1,_Paths_:_,_Condition_:_AND_,_RestItems_:_Type_:_param_,_Name_:_name_,_Value_:_xiaoming_,_Cond_:_==_,_Operator_:_rawvalue' --EntryRules.1.Priority 1 --EntryRules.1.Condition AND --EntryRules.1.RestItems.1.Type header --EntryRules.1.Paths.1 '/' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Id '-1' --Tag gray
